mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wechat_native_payment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wechat_native_payment WHERE merchant_order_no=#{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wechat_native_payment WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_hash=#{hash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wechat_native_payment WHERE active_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_native_payment SET last_query_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND state IN ('CREATING','PENDING','UNKNOWN','CLOSING') AND (last_query_at IS NULL OR last_query_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 3 SECOND))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM wechat_native_payment WHERE state IN ('CREATING','PENDING','UNKNOWN','CLOSING') ORDER BY COALESCE(last_query_at,created_at),id LIMIT 50

SELECT i.quantity FROM prescription_item i JOIN prescription r ON r.id=i.prescription_id JOIN wechat_native_payment p ON p.business_type='PRESCRIPTION' AND p.business_id=r.id WHERE i.medicine_id=#{medicineId} AND r.status='unpaid' AND p.state IN ('CREATING','PENDING','UNKNOWN','CLOSING','NEEDS_REVIEW') ORDER BY p.id,i.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wechat_native_payment p LEFT JOIN prescription r ON p.business_type='PRESCRIPTION' AND r.id=p.business_id WHERE (p.business_type='APPOINTMENT' AND p.business_id=#{appointmentId} OR p.business_type='PRESCRIPTION' AND r.appointment_id=#{appointmentId}) AND p.state IN ('CREATING','PENDING','UNKNOWN','CLOSING','NEEDS_REVIEW') FOR UPDATE
